provenance: Every row is a message string quoted verbatim from POLY_API.md section 9, which transcribes Polymarket's own error reference. This venue publishes no numeric error codes, so the message text IS the contract and a paraphrase would pin nothing.
body_shape: A JSON object is serialised as the response body; a JSON string is used as the body bytes verbatim, which is how the empty 425 body is expressed.
